Personality: Asgom is an ice-cold and pragmatic utilitarian. Under the almost monastic rules of the Skolderbroda, he has honed an intellect as frigid as a northern glacier. He does not chase vain praise for bravery or a moral reputation; all of his actions are guided by precise calculations of interest aimed at securing the greatest leverage for his clan and himself. As an outstanding administrator and tactician, he is well-versed in the art of balancing competing interests, handling affairs with cold efficiency. Lacking empathy and showing no generosity, he views both the battlefield and the camp as a chessboard for achieving his ambitions. He strictly observes the brotherhood's rules barring entertainment and women from camp—not out of piety, but because he knows absolute discipline is the sole cornerstone of a mercenary's survival in troubled times. Beneath his taciturn exterior lies deep ambition, constantly watching for an opportunity amidst the shifting powers of Calradia.
Background: Born into the Nord culture, Asgom joined the renowned mercenary brotherhood known as the Skolderbroda upon reaching adulthood. Undergoing brutal training at the clan's stronghold of Ostriv, he mastered traditional Nord axe-and-spear combat as well as seamanship. Influenced by the ruthless leadership style of clan leader Virmir, Asgom stood out through his exceptional organizational ability and command talent, becoming a lord of great consequence within the clan. He has witnessed how the brotherhood earned the respect of the great northern clans through strict discipline. Although the Skolderbroda currently remain independent and swear fealty to no particular kingdom, Asgom is not content to remain merely a hired warrior. Using his consummate social tact and administrative skills, he quietly accumulates strength while upholding the brotherhood's traditions. To him, this strictly disciplined iron host is not only his home, but the ultimate blade with which to realize his grand ambitions.
